subheadline: A small team focused on thoughtful web experiences.
body:
Northline helps organizations ship websites and admin tools that stay maintainable. We care about readable content, honest UX, and backends that are easy to evolve.

This about page is editable from the admin panel. Update the headline, team story, and mission whenever your brand shifts.
mission: Make content management approachable without locking teams into heavy CMS platforms.
vision: Give every site a focused admin experience that matches how editors actually work.
teamIntro: Editors, designers, and engineers collaborating in short feedback loops.
